steps.description: Load the homepage at the root URL '/'
Check that the hero section contains a headline, subheadline, and CTA buttons
Confirm primary CTA shows 'Get Started' or 'Sign Up' text and secondary shows 'Login'

test_cases.expected: Hero section displays with headline containing URL shortening messaging

test_cases.input: Check for 'Login' link or button in hero
test_cases.expected: Secondary login option is present in hero section

test_cases.input: Navigate to homepage as unauthenticated user in browser
test_cases.expected: Hero section loads within 2 seconds with all elements visible
